shortDescription: Deploy a VM from a template located in a folder

options.name: cluster
options.description: The name or MOID of the cluster where the VM should be deployed. Changing this option will not result in the VM being redeployed (it does not affect idempotency). O(resource_pool) and O(cluster) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The name or MOID of the datacenter to use when searching for and deploying resources.

options.name: datastore
options.description: Name or MOID of the datastore to store deployed VM and disk. O(datastore) and O(datastore_cluster) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: datastore_cluster
options.description: Name or MOID of the datastore cluster to store deployed VM and disk. Please make sure Storage DRS is active for recommended datastore from the given datastore cluster. If Storage DRS is not enabled, datastore with largest free storage space is selected. O(datastore) and O(datastore_cluster) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: esxi_host
options.description: The name of the ESXi host onto which the virtual machine should be deployed. If O(esxi_host) and O(resource_pool) are both specified, O(resource_pool) must belong to O(esxi_host). If O(esxi_host) and O(cluster) are both specified, O(esxi_host) must be a member of O(cluster). Changing this option will not result in the VM being redeployed (it does not affect idempotency).

options.name: folder_paths_are_absolute
options.description: If true, any folder path parameters are treated as absolute paths. If false, modules will try to intelligently determine if the path is absolute or relative. This option is useful when your environment has a complex folder structure. By default, modules will try to intelligently determine if the path is absolute or relative. They may mistakenly prepend the datacenter name or other folder names, and this option can be used to avoid this.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: power_on_after_deploy
options.description: Whether or not the VM should be powered on once it has been deployed. This is only applied when the VM is deployed. If the VM already exists, the power state is not modified. Changing this option will not result in the VM being redeployed (it does not affect idempotency).

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: resource_pool
options.description: The name or MOID of a resource pool into which the virtual machine should be deployed. Changing this option will not result in the VM being redeployed (it does not affect idempotency). O(resource_pool) and O(cluster) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: template_folder
options.description: The path to the folder where the template with O(template_name) exists. This parameter is not used if O(template_id) is supplied. This can be an absolute (/datacenter/vm/my/folder) or relative (my/folder) path. This parameter is mutually exclusive with O(template_folder_id).

options.name: template_folder_id
options.description: The ID of the folder where the template with O(template_name) exists. This parameter is not used if O(template_id) is supplied. This parameter is mutually exclusive with O(template_folder).

options.name: template_id
options.description: The ID of the template to use when deploying. This parameter takes precedence over O(template_name) and O(template_folder)

options.name: template_name
options.description: The name of the template to use when deploying. You must also supply O(template_folder) if you use this parameter. This parameter is not used if O(template_id) is supplied.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vm_folder
options.description: Virtual machine folder into which the virtual machine should be deployed. This can be the absolute folder path, or a relative folder path under /<datacenter>/vm/. See the examples for more info. This option is required if you have more than one VM with the same name in the datacenter. Changing this option will result in the VM being redeployed, since it affects where the module looks for the deployed VM. If not provided, the /<datacenter>/vm/ folder is used.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: The name of the VM to deploy. If you have multiple VMs with the same name, you should also supply O(vm_folder)
